items.description: Before this list, there exist other lists to summarize the resources about SDN, such as Google SDN Reading List, ONF Recommended SDN Reading List and Awesome SDN from sdnds-tw. But these lists only focus on one aspect of the classic research papers, popular opensource projects and well-known communities. In my opinion, a comprehensive list about all of the aspects I just mentioned is necessary. Both beginners and professional people will benefit from it.
items.title: Background

items.description: The initial version is forked from SDNDS-TW but re-organized. Thanks again!
items.title: Software Projects
Floodlight
items.description: A java-based openflow controller.

items.title: POX
items.description: A networking software platform written in Python

items.title: NOX
items.description: An open source development platform for C++-based software-defined networking (SDN) control applications.

items.title: Beehive Network Controller
items.description: A distributed SDN controller built on top of Beehive. It supports OpenFlow but can be easily extended for other southbound protocols.

items.title: NodeFlow
items.description: An OpenFlow Controller Node Style.

items.title: Vyatta
items.description: The first commercial Controller built directly from OpenDaylight.

items.title: OESS
items.description: The Open Exchange Software Suite to configure and control OpenFlow Enabled switches.

items.title: Ravel
items.description: A software-defined networking (SDN) controller that uses a standard SQL database to represent the network.

items.title: snabbswitch
items.description: An open source virtualized Ethernet networking stack.

items.title: CPqD
items.description: An OpenFlow 1.3 compatible user-space software switch implementation

items.title: LINC-Switch
items.description: A pure OpenFlow software switch written in Erlang

items.title: Indigo
items.description: Indigo is an open source project aimed at enabling support for OpenFlow on physical and hypervisor switches.
TBD
items.title: SDN Application
FlowVisor
items.description: An OpenFlow controller that acts as a hypervisor/proxy between a switch and multiple controllers. Can slice multiple switches in parallel, effectively slicing a network.

items.title: OpenVirtex
items.description: A network hypervisor that can create multiple virtual and programmable networks on top of a single physical infrastructure.

items.title: loxigen
items.description: LoxiGen is a tool that generates OpenFlow protocol libraries for a number of languages.

items.title: openfaucet
items.description: openfaucet is a pure Python implementation of the OpenFlow 1.0.0 protocol, based on Twisted.

items.title: oflib-node
items.description: Oflib-node is an OpenFlow protocol library for Node. It converts between OpenFlow wire protocol messages and Javascript objects.

items.title: OCaml OpenFlow
items.description: A serialization and protocol library for OpenFlow.

items.title: OpenNet
items.description: A simulator for software-defined wireless local area network.

items.title: Multinet
items.description: The goal of Multinet is to provide a fast, controlled and resource-efficient way to boot large-scale SDN topologies.

items.title: oftest
items.description: OpenFlow Testing Framework.

items.title: OFLOPS
items.description: OpenFlow Operations Per Second. A benchmarking suite for openflow switches.
